_help: Hand-edited. Keys are agency_id or agency_id/system_id (the more specific wins). Fields: hide, note, status (ok|stale|gps_only|low_match|thin|empty), reason, trip_match (0-1), trips_per_day, large. Overrides beat the probe. After editing, run: node scripts/validate-feeds.mjs

broward-county-transit.note: The feed stopped publishing in July. Pick another agency for current data.

bigbluebus.note: The archive has no schedule that joins to this feed's trip IDs, so trip, on-time and run-time figures are blank.

ddot-detroit.note: No schedule joins to this feed, and the archive states no time zone, so America/New_York is estimated.

sound-transit.note: Trips whose IDs are not in the schedule are left out, so headline figures rest on a partial match.

metrolink.note: Few trips a day: an overnight "slowest hour" can come from a handful of trains.

mta.note: Very large feed (about 51,000 trips a day). Expect around a minute, and a tab that may freeze while it runs.

king-county-metro.note: Large service (about 12,000 trips a day). Expect about 20 seconds and a sluggish tab.

metro-transit-mpls.note: Large feed. Expect about 20 seconds and a sluggish tab.
